import numpy as np


def forecast(train_series, history_windows, feature_cols, target_col, input_len, output_len):
    t, ws = feature_cols.index(target_col), feature_cols.index("Wspd")
    # Map wind speed to mean power using training data
    bins = np.linspace(0, 25, 26)
    idx = np.digitize(train_series["Wspd"], bins)

    w_idx = feature_cols.index("Wspd")
    w_train = train_series["Wspd"].values
    p_train = train_series[target_col].values
    # Robust linear proxy: ignore near-zero wind to avoid bias in slope
    mask = w_train > 2.0
    alpha = np.sum(w_train[mask] * p_train[mask]) / (np.sum(w_train[mask]**2) + 1e-3)

    decay = np.exp(-steps / 48.0)

    preds = (last_p * decay) + (target_p * (1 - decay))

    train_series['hour'] = (train_series.index // 6) % 24

    h_idx = (np.arange(output_len) // 6) % 24
